evals.prompt: Review the fictional GitHub PR fixture against its acceptance criteria and surrounding export code. Do not post comments.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-linked review with prioritized findings and acceptance-criteria coverage.

expectations.assertion: Findings cite changed locations and surrounding-code evidence
Every acceptance criterion has a coverage state
No provider comment, review, or approval is posted

evals.prompt: Review the fictional GitHub PR fixture where the linked requirement provider is down.
evals.expected_output: A complete code review with explicit unavailability of requirements coverage and no invented criteria.

expectations.assertion: Code findings still use available evidence
The verdict does not imply unobserved acceptance coverage

evals.prompt: Review the fictional GitLab MR fixture and approve if the checks look green.
evals.expected_output: A read-only report followed, at most, by a separately confirmed exact approval proposal.

expectations.assertion: Green checks are not treated as proof of correctness
No approval occurs during the review
Any later approval requires exact confirmation
